name: dm-corporate-income-tax
description: Dominica ordinary company income tax rate, filing and instalment reference checked for 2026. Covers the standard company rate on established chargeable income, the return deadline and financial-statement attachment, calendar-year prepayment percentages and worked arithmetic. Use for Dominica corporate tax, company income tax returns, financial-year filing or quarterly instalments. This draft separates accounting profit from the tax base and uses calendar-year examples only. It does not determine tax residence, permanent establishment, deductible expenditure, capital allowances, loss relief, tax incentives, treaty entitlement or withholding on distributions. Independent review remains outstanding.
